capabilities: Run multi-model discussions with turns, conclusions, and voting
Solve riddles, mysteries, and logic puzzles collaboratively
Play Keyword Wolf social deduction with AI and human players
Aggregate text models from provider plugins like LLM Hub and Gemini Helper
Save transcripts, votes, and outcomes as Markdown notes
disambiguation: Not a community forum or note commenting tool; it stages AI and human participants in structured activities like debates and a deduction game.
extras: The marketplace listing notes it has not been manually reviewed by Obsidian staff. Requires Obsidian 1.10.0 or later. Documents a developer-facing workspace-event contract (discussion-hub:register-integration) for third-party provider plugins; provider credentials stay inside the provider plugins.
problem: Obsidian AI plugins each expose their own models in isolation, so models from different providers cannot take part in one shared structured discussion.

relations.evidence: Mix models supplied by LLM Hub, Gemini Helper, and Local LLM Hub in one discussion.
Providers register a protocolVersion: 1 integration through the discussion-hub:register-integration workspace event

requires.name: At least one supported AI provider plugin (LLM Hub, Gemini Helper, or Local LLM Hub)

summary: Multi-model discussion hub that stages structured debates, riddle solving, and Keyword Wolf games between AI models from connected provider plugins.
